events.name: LPL 2026 Split 1
events.formatSummary: 14 teams split 6/4/4 by 2025 performance; intra-group double round robin Bo3, hybrid Knights Rivals Bo5, then eight-team double-elimination Bo5.

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.structure: Three seeded groups: Ascend 6, Perseverance 4, Nirvana 4; double round robin within each group.
stages.firstSelectionRule: First meeting Game 1 random; return meeting alternates; prior-game loser gets next-game First Selection (secondary structured source).
advancement: Ascend bottom 2 + Perseverance top 2 -> Knights Rivals Round 1
Perseverance bottom 2 + Nirvana top 2 -> Knights Rivals Round 2

stages.name: Knights Rivals
stages.structure: Hybrid elimination: two Round-1 winners qualify directly; Round-1 losers join two Round-2 winners, reseeded for Round 3; two Round-3 winners qualify.
stages.firstSelectionRule: Higher group/regular-season seed gets Game 1 First Selection; prior-game loser gets subsequent First Selection (secondary structured source).

stages.name: Knockout Stage
stages.structure: Standard eight-team double-elimination bracket; Group Ascend direct qualifiers choose upper-quarterfinal opponents in seed order.
stages.firstSelectionRule: Upper-quarterfinal direct qualifiers receive Game 1 entitlement; later rounds follow event First Selection rules (secondary structured source).

seriesCount.derivation: Standard eight-team double elimination with no grand-final reset

events.name: LPL 2026 Split 2
events.formatSummary: Top eight from Split 1 form Ascend and play double round robin; remaining six form Nirvana and play single round robin; four direct and four Knights winners enter an eight-team double-elimination playoff.

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.structure: Ascend 8 double round robin; Nirvana 6 single round robin.
stages.firstSelectionRule: First meeting Game 1 coin flip; Ascend return meeting alternates; prior-game loser gets next-game First Selection.
advancement: Ascend top 4 -> Knockout Stage (selected because completed bracket and structured source require four; official overview surface said top two)
Nirvana bottom 2 -> eliminated from remaining 2026 LPL season

stages.name: Knights Rivals
stages.structure: Four independent cross-group Bo5 qualification series.
stages.firstSelectionRule: Ascend team receives Game 1 First Selection; prior-game loser receives later-game entitlement.

seriesCount.derivation: Eight teams paired into four qualification series

stages.name: Knockout Stage
stages.structure: Standard eight-team double-elimination bracket, all Bo5.
stages.firstSelectionRule: Direct qualifiers choose upper-quarterfinal opponents; detailed First Selection follows event rules.

seriesCount.derivation: Standard eight-team double elimination with no reset

events.name: LPL 2026 Split 3
events.formatSummary: Twelve remaining teams split into Ascend 8 and Nirvana 4; both double round robin Bo3; six direct playoff teams and two Knights winners enter a modified double-elimination playoff.

stages.name: Group Stage
stages.structure: Ascend 8 and Nirvana 4, each playing double round robin Bo3.
stages.firstSelectionRule: 2026 First Selection; exact round entitlement follows LPL event rules.
advancement: Ascend bottom 2 + Nirvana top 2 -> Knights Rivals

stages.name: Knights Rivals
stages.structure: Two direct Bo5 qualification series between Ascend bottom two and Nirvana top two.
advancement: Two winners -> lower-bracket entry in Season Playoffs

seriesCount.derivation: Four entrants paired into two Bo5s

stages.name: Season Playoffs
stages.structure: Modified double elimination: Ascend top two receive upper-semifinal byes; Ascend 3-6 start upper quarterfinals; Knights winners enter lower round 1.
advancement: Highest season Championship Points among non-champion -> Worlds as LPL #2
Up to four next-highest CP teams -> Regional Finals

seriesCount.derivation: 2 UBQF + 2 UBSF + UBF + 2 LBR1 + 2 LBQF + LBSF + LBF + GF

qualification.method: highest season Championship Points excluding champion

notes: Official LPL surface expresses 2–3 remaining regional-final Worlds places because the global bonus is conditional.
As of 2026-09-06 BLG finished MSI runner-up, so Riot's runner-up-region bonus makes the current LPL allocation four Worlds teams; the Regional Finals therefore sends two.

events.name: LPL 2026 Regional Finals
events.participantSelection: Up to four highest Championship Point teams excluding Split 3 champion and highest-CP automatic qualifier; CP ties favor more Split 3 points.
events.formatSummary: Four-team modified double elimination: top two CP teams begin upper, next two begin lower; upper-path winner and surviving lower-path winner qualify.

stages.name: Regional Final Bracket
stages.structure: Upper match between CP seeds 1-2; lower elimination between CP seeds 3-4; upper loser meets lower winner.

seriesCount.derivation: Upper qualifier + lower elimination + lower qualifier

worldsRules: Highest total CP team not already champion is LPL #2.
If tied on total CP, higher Split 3 points rank higher.
Current 2026 global bonus gives LPL two Regional Finals berths to Worlds (#3 and #4).

promotionRelegation.rule: LPL partner-team field; no 2026 sporting promotion/relegation path modeled.

events.name: LEC Versus 2026

stages.name: Versus Regular Season

stages.name: Versus Playoffs
stages.structure: Eight-team double-elimination bracket.
stages.firstSelectionRule: 2026 First Selection applies to multi-game series; exact entitlement follows event rules.

seriesCount.derivation: Standard eight-team double elimination with no reset

events.name: LEC 2026 Spring
events.formatSummary: Ten-team single-round-robin Bo3; top six to all-Bo5 double elimination; top two qualify to MSI.

stages.name: Spring Regular Season
stages.structure: Single round robin, Bo3.

stages.name: Spring Playoffs
stages.structure: Six-team double elimination: top four begin upper; seeds 5-6 begin lower; all series Bo5.

events.name: LEC 2026 Summer

stages.structure: Single round robin, Bo3.

stages.name: Split 1 Hybrid Playoffs

events.formatSummary: Split 1 structure retained; champion qualifies to MSI, and the highest Championship Point team excluding champion takes the second MSI slot.

stages.name: Split 2 Regular Season

stages.name: Split 2 Hybrid Playoffs

events.name: LCP 2026 Split 3
events.formatSummary: Eight-team Swiss to three wins or three losses; qualification/elimination series are Bo5 and other series Bo3; final seeding then four-team double-elimination Bo5 playoffs.

stages.name: Split 3 Swiss Stage
stages.structure: Record-matched Swiss; opening top four from Split 2 are drawn against bottom four; later rounds pair same records with no rematch unless unavoidable.
advancement: First four teams to three wins -> Final Seeding
tiebreakers: At 2-1/1-2, loser of 2-0 faces winner of 0-2; 1-1 teams are drawn
Teams tied after three losses play for +5 CP

seriesCount.derivation: Swiss series count varies with records and required 3-loss tie resolution

stages.name: Final Seeding Matches
stages.structure: Bo5 seeding matches determine playoff ordering; a separate three-loss tie match determines the +5 CP bonus where necessary.

seriesCount.derivation: Public primer describes function but not a single fixed bracket count for every tie state

stages.name: Split 3 Playoffs
stages.structure: Four-team double-elimination, all Bo5; finals weekend in Taipei.
advancement: Highest cumulative CP team not already top two -> Worlds 2026

seriesCount.derivation: Standard four-team double elimination with no reset

qualification.method: highest cumulative CP excluding top two

events.name: LCP 2026 Promotion Series
events.formatSummary: Domestic-league challengers face selected LCP Guest teams. Dates and selection principles are official; exact bracket/mechanism remained reserved for a later announcement in the checked official sources.

qualificationUses: Split 2 second MSI seed: highest cumulative CP excluding champion.

guestSelection: Guest team qualified for Worlds is exempt.

lcsLastChanceBestOf.basis: N01/N02 confirm one elimination Series but omit BO length; V1 explicitly adopts BO3

lcpFinalSeeding.rule: If two teams finish 3-1, BO5 between them; winner faces 3-0 for seed 1. The other two playoff entrants are third seeds. Three-loss tied pairs play BO5 for +5 CP.

firstSelection.rule: Seeded first regular meeting, alternate return, higher actual event seed for knockout; previous game loser receives later choice through common Series. LCP 2v2 is replaced by this policy; no extra simulated showdown.

ties.rule: Use published comparator chain where supplied. Remaining LPL group ties use a seeded BO3 ladder for placement; other unresolved equal records use a stable event draw. Summer LEC adds overall game percentage before strength of victory and Spring placement. CBLOL simultaneous fifth/sixth-place elimination is ordered by regular placement for the distinct published prize slots. LCP elimination ties use the played tiebreak winner for final ordering.

schedule.rule: Project reference local month/day into Career year without UTC conversion; distribute RR rounds within regular window, then dependency rounds at least one day apart for same team. Missing LCP/LCS regular boundaries are explicit authored windows. Maximum seven-day local overflow, global collisions deferred within finite event window.

bootstrap.rule: First LPL groups use event-seeded partner draw, never real 2026 survivors. Later groups use sealed prior results; all 14 partners re-enter next Split 1.

adoption.growthTravel: Use existing Career growth and fatigue rules unchanged; no new jet lag, travel or bootcamp ability rewards.

guestOwnership.rule: KCB competes separately with KC employment and finance ownership; played players cannot enter another Series on the same logical day. OMG, UP and LR use regional-median estimated extension accounts; missing positions enter normal FA recruitment with bounded generated-player supply.
